app_identity.name: Lingua
app_identity.description: Real-time AI auto-translating messaging web application where every participant reads and writes in their native language effortlessly.
app_identity.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast meets Tactile Modern Messaging
app_identity.target_audience: Global teams, multilingual families, cross-border creators, and language learners
key_differentiators: Native RTL layout direction switching (Arabic, Hebrew, Urdu, Persian)
Tap-to-toggle original vs translated text with subtle animations
Translating indicator with shimmer effect and zero layout jumps
WhatsApp Web / Telegram Web desktop layout and adaptive mobile single-column view

tech_stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v3 + CSS custom properties for light/dark themes
tech_stack.components: shadcn/ui primitives heavily customized (Dialog, Sheet, Command, Popover, Avatar, Badge, DropdownMenu, Tabs, ScrollArea, Tooltip, Sonner)
tech_stack.animation: framer-motion (for smooth height transitions, bubble slide-ins, drawer transitions)

theme_and_colors.mode_switch: System preference auto-detection with manual light/dark toggle persisted in localStorage

light.input_bg: bg-slate-100 border-slate-200 text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:bg-white focus:border-indigo-500

dark.input_bg: bg-zinc-800/80 border-zinc-700 text-zinc-100 placeholder:text-zinc-500 focus:bg-zinc-800 focus:border-indigo-500

typography.font_family_latin: Outfit, Satoshi, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
typography.font_family_rtl: Tajawal, Cairo, 'Noto Sans Arabic', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

desktop.structure: Three-pane split desktop view (Left sidebar, Center chat, Right details pane)
desktop.info_panel_width: w-72 lg:w-80 border-l flex-shrink-0 transition-all duration-300

mobile.structure: Single-column screen stack view with slide animations and full back button header
mobile.header_back: Visible on mobile view with user avatar and name

rtl_support.detection: Auto-detect layout direction based on target language code (e.g. ar, he, ur, fa set dir='rtl')
rtl_support.flex_logic: Use logical Tailwind classes like ms-auto, me-auto, ps-4, pe-4, rounded-s-2xl, rounded-e-2xl instead of absolute left/right

message_bubble.design: Asymmetric rounded corners (Sent: rounded-2xl rounded-tr-xs; Received: rounded-2xl rounded-tl-xs). Contains timestamp, read ticks, translation indicator badge, and toggle text button.
states: translated_default (shows target user's native text + pill badge 'Translated from [Language]')
original_revealed (shows original text with 'Original text' pill badge)
translating_shimmer (shows pulse skeleton bubble with animated globe icon)
failed_retry (shows error pill with 'Retry translation' button)
actions: Tap badge or text to toggle between original and translated
Hover / Long press action bar: Copy original, Copy translated, Speak TTS, React emoji

language_picker.onboarding_modal: Searchable 40+ languages modal with flag emojis, native language names, and search filter
language_picker.quick_switcher: Header dropdown for instant active target language switching

contact_requests.banner: Top notification bar for incoming contact requests with Accept / Decline / Block actions
contact_requests.badge: Unread request count badge on sidebar tab

chat_input.position: Sticky bottom bar with auto-resizing textarea, emoji picker trigger, audio message toggle, source language selector badge, and send button
chat_input.typing_indicator: Shows 'User is typing [in Spanish]...' with triple animated bouncing dots

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow React JS syntax (.js / .jsx). Do NOT write TypeScript type annotations in React component files.
Implement light and dark mode smoothly with Tailwind classes and CSS variables. Default to dark mode or auto system preference.
Add 'dir' attribute handling dynamically: if target language is RTL (Arabic, Hebrew, Urdu, Persian), apply 'dir="rtl"' on chat containers or message bubbles.
Ensure ALL interactive elements carry explicit data-testid attributes according to the test_ids schema.
Use framer-motion for smooth height expansions when revealing original text to guarantee ZERO layout jumps.
Pre-populate realistic multilingual chat conversations (English, Spanish, Japanese, Arabic, French, German) with real translation states.
Provide a simulated translation server delay (300-600ms) with typing indicators and shimmer skeleton bubbles to demonstrate the 'translating...' state.
Use sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'Language updated', 'Contact request accepted', 'Text copied to clipboard').
